release.body:
# 14.0.30-next

- **Silent updates**: the app now updates itself without a tap. It installs through the running server first, then through a no-dialog installer, and only shows the system prompt if both refuse.
- **Hung server recovery**: the server now detects that its main thread has stopped answering and restarts itself instead of leaving apps hanging.
- **Debugging switches on home**: developer options, USB debugging and wireless debugging can be toggled right under the start buttons.
- **Debugging switches in Labs**: the same three, switchable from Labs, and they work even with the server stopped.
- **Tiles and widgets for every Labs switch**: service, firewall, autostart, all hiding settings, force dark, watchdog and the debugging modes.
- **Firewall tile and widget**: turns the whole block list on or off in one tap, blocks are kept while it is off.
- **One-cell widgets**: a switch widget can now sit in a single icon-sized cell.
- **All app ops listed**: the Apps screen reads every op the platform reports instead of only the ones the app knew about.
